title: Samuel Hears God Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Samuel Hears God Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Samuel Bible crossword: the child at Shiloh, Eli the priest, and “Speak; for thy servant heareth.” KJV clues, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: The word of the LORD was precious in those days, and there was no open vision. A child lies down in the temple where the ark is, and a voice calls his name three times before anyone works out who is speaking. Samuel Hears God turns 1 Samuel 3 into a quiet, gentle grid.
The clues cover Hannah's vow and the linen ephod as well as the night itself. The closing verse is the answer Eli finally taught him to give.

clues.text: Child who ministered unto the LORD before Eli
The aged priest whose eyes waxed dim
Where the temple of the LORD then stood

verseText: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.
